label: Inloggning — Supabase
summary: Supabase Auth provider under the shared 'auth' capability (clerk-auth is the default; this dossier wins on an EXPLICIT Supabase ask via relevanceKeywords). Ships the wiring only: cookie-based SSR sessions, middleware session refresh, server + browser client factories, a config guard and an OAuth code-exchange callback route. It ships NO login form — author the sign-in/sign-up UI yourself on top of createSupabaseBrowserClient(). Demo mode (mock: visual): gate submit on isSupabaseAuthConfigured() and render the shipped SupabaseAuthNotice — never a fake session.
summarySv: Inloggning via Supabase. Väljs när sajten uttryckligen ska använda Supabase för konton. Inloggningsformuläret ritas som en del av sajten; e-post, lösenord eller OAuth-leverantörer slår du på i ditt Supabase-projekt. Utan riktiga nycklar visas inloggningsytan i demoläge med en tydlig notis — ingen låtsas-inloggning sker.

envVars.purpose: Supabase project URL used by the browser, server, middleware and callback clients (Supabase project → API settings). Tagged 'feature-runtime': auth cannot work without a real value, but the code degrades at runtime (middleware passes through, UI shows the 'Auth ej konfigurerat' notice) instead of crashing — a missing value is an F3 warning, not a build blocker.

Supabase anon public API key used by the browser, server, middleware and callback clients (Supabase project → API settings). Tagged 'feature-runtime' like NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: the code degrades to the unconfigured-auth notice at runtime instead of throwing, so a missing value is a runtime warning rather than a hard build blocker.
